title: Information Systems Manager
job_description:
Minimum degree for both positions Knowledge in AI (added advantange) Minimum 5 years of working experience for Manager position Domain experience & technical skills Leadership to manage the department for Manager position

1. Design, develop, implement, maintain and project manage major IT projects including auto count system, existing website, and upgrades. 2. Work with respective vendors to explore or study new system/ technology to meet company requirements. 3. Liaise with end user, management, and suppliers. 4. Managing and maintaining computer networks, including troubleshooting problems when they occur. 5. Collaborate with internal departments such as marketing and sales department on online sales support. 6. Communicate periodically on the status of active projects, according to reasonable and agreed-upon timeframes. 7. Manage workflow, estimate costs and efforts, and fulfil deadlines on several, concurrent projects. 8. Complete any additional tasks provided by Superior.

Attractive package with yearly performance bonus Staff Benefit - Medical claims & leaves, EPF, SOCSO,EIS Career growth opportunities & training provided
